name: Skeleton
summary: Gray shapes with a soft shine where content will appear. Shows the layout early, so the page does not jump.
use: Lists, cards and tables that take longer than about half a second to load.
avoid: Short actions inside a button: use Loading on Button.
anatomy: Text: a line of text (the last line is shorter).
figmaProps: Change the width and height for each use.
behaviour: The shine moves from left to right. With "reduce motion" it stands still.
a11y: Set aria-busy="true" on the container and announce "Loading …" in a status region.
do: Follow the real layout as closely as you can.
dont: Show skeletons for more than a few seconds without an explanation.
